messages:
Carmen (Eng Manager): Heads up team 94 we want to promote Pri to IC4 mid-cycle and increase base + small refresher RSU. What's the exact packet and timing? Can we set effective date to employee's 1-year anniversary?
Priya (People Ops): Congrats! :tada: For a level change, submit a leveling packet (one-paragraph justification + recent performance bullets) and the comp-change request with requested salary, effective_date, equity request, and headcount tag = existing. If you want anniversary effective_date that's fine but payroll cutoff still applies.
Carmen (Eng Manager): Asking for effective_date = 2026-04-02 (one-year anniversary). Proposed base $168,000 -> $185,000 and pro-rated RSU.
Diego (Compensation): That's ~10% increase. If it's exactly 10% we can typically approve via comp ops; >10% requires comp committee. Please attach market comps and a short note about scope/responsibility increase.
Nia (Payroll): US payroll cutoff is 4 business days before pay date. If approvals are in after cutoff we can do retro adjustment in next run or an off-cycle (off-cycle needs Finance signoff). Also provide employee last 4 SSN for payroll feed.
Carmen (Eng Manager): Any guidance about communication? I don't want to promise numbers before approval.
Priya (People Ops): Don't promise final comp. Say "promotion being submitted; timeline 3-7 business days." If retention risk, mark 'expedite' and include reason.
Carmen (Eng Manager): Submitted leveling packet + comp form, attached market data, set expedite: retention risk.
PeopleOpsBot: Leveling packet URL: https://redwood.company/hr/leveling_packet 94 set `expedite=true` to flag. For comp >10% set `needs_comp_committee=true`.
Diego (Compensation): Received. Quick checklist: manager justification, performance bullets, budget code. We'll triage within 24 hours and route to comp committee if needed.
Priya (People Ops): Routing now. ETA leveling committee 1-2 business days; comp committee 1-3 business days if needed. Nia, watch payroll cutoff for 2026-04-02 effective_date.
Nia (Payroll): Noted. If comp committee clears after payroll cutoff we'll prepare retro adjustment. Off-cycle payment possible but please expect processing fees.
Diego (Compensation): Leveling approved and comp committee cleared the increase and RSU. Priya, prepare official comp letter and notify Payroll.
Priya (People Ops): Preparing letters. Carmen, please do not share final numbers until you get the official comp letter. We'll aim to include effective_date = 2026-04-02 in the next run if approvals are in before cutoff.
Carmen (Eng Manager): Thanks everyone 94 will wait for the comp letter before communicating to Pri.
